new_fetches.licence_citation: CobayaSampler/bao_data -- CC0 (public data from DESI surveys); same trusted repo/commit family as the already-verified desi_2024_bao_all.txt mean file
new_fetches.description: Full 12x12 covariance matrix for the DESI 2024 gaussian BAO ALL_GCcomb consensus means already in data/real/dark_energy/desi_2024_bao_all.txt. Row/column order verified by direct inspection to match that file's 12 (z, quantity) rows exactly (block-diagonal per z, matching DESI's public release convention).

datasets_confirmed_absent_or_unusable_th.reason: unzip -l + inspection of ceffyl_data/*/ shows only density.npy, freqs.npy, log10rhogrid.npy, bandwidths.npy per analysis folder -- a per-frequency free-spectrum KDE, not an inter-pulsar angular-separation Gamma(theta) dataset with errors. No real angular-correlation likelihood exists in the verified data for pta.gamma_theta / pta.max_deviation_from_hd to be chi2-tested against.

data/real/cosmic_web/2mrs_sample.tsv columns are 2MASS-ID, RA, Dec, Kmag only (verified by head -5 / VizieR header) -- no redshift/velocity column, so comoving 3D coordinates cannot be derived from the verified set without inventing a Kmag-to-distance relation (forbidden). Used instead as a 2D RA/Dec angular-patch cloud (known S^2 topology) for one extra real-data TDA check; NOT the comoving galaxy-catalogue analysis the task's first TDA option describes for that option.
